response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization, all of which are core requirements for this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is almost entirely in web platforms, TypeScript/Node.js, and general backend systems, with no evidence of chip/hardware performance engineering.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career (15+ years) meeting seniority/experience bar
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic
Strong self-driven learner and communicator (talks, workshops, open source projects)
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture design
No evidence of GPU/AI accelerator or deep-learning workload optimization work
Background is web/full-stack focused, not systems/hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No GPU/AI accelerator or deep-learning optimization background
Strong general engineering seniority and experience level
